stem:
Farid compares how a tadpole and an adult frog use body parts for breathing. His cards name gills, lungs, and moist skin.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: The tadpole uses gills; the adult frog uses lungs and moist skin.
The tadpole uses lungs and moist skin; the adult frog uses gills.
The tadpole uses lungs and moist skin; the adult frog uses lungs and moist skin.
The tadpole uses gills; the adult frog uses gills.

teacher.key_rationale: Tadpoles breathe with gills; adult frogs use lungs and moist skin as a life-stage habitat adaptation.
